patthana15.15:1.1: hetuṃ micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na micchattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.15:2.1: hetuṃ sammattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sammattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.15:3.1: nahetuṃ aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. hetuduka maggārammaṇattike nahetuduka namaggārammaṇattikaṃ
